en.headline: Police reports on two closed luxury consignment shops rise to nearly HK$51 million
en.dek: Police said they have received nearly 400 reports alleging unpaid payments totalling almost HK$51.2 million after the two shops in Causeway Bay and Admiralty closed abruptly.
body: Police said the number of reports concerning two second-hand luxury consignment shops that closed suddenly has risen to 393, with combined alleged losses of about HK$51.2 million.

Officers received 289 reports involving roughly HK$38 million related to a shop on Russell Street in Causeway Bay, and 104 reports involving about HK$13.18 million concerning a shop on Harcourt Road in Admiralty. The force previously put the figures at HK$42 million and 303 reports.

The cases have been classified as fraud and are being investigated by the crime investigation teams of the Wan Chai and Central police districts. The shops, known as Vootic and Obsessplanet, became unreachable after ceasing operations, leaving consignors unable to recover goods or payments.

zh.headline: 兩間二手名牌寄賣店突然結業 警方接獲近400宗報案涉款約5120萬元
zh.dek: 警方表示已接獲近400宗報案，指銅鑼灣及金鐘兩間寄賣店拖欠款項，涉及金額約5120萬元，案件列為詐騙調查中。
body: 警方表示，兩間突然結業的二手名牌寄賣店相關報案數字已升至393宗，涉款共約5120萬元。
其中針對銅鑼灣羅素街一間店舖的報案有289宗，涉款約3800萬元；針對金鐘夏懣道一間店舖的則有104宗，涉款約1318萬元。警方早前公布的數字為4200萬元及303宗。
案件已列為詐騙，由灣仔及中區警區刑事調查隊跟進。有關店舖分別名為Vootic及Obsessplanet，結業後負責人失聯，寄賣者無法取回貨品或款項。
